alt: A humanoid robot waving a flag during a street demonstration in Warsaw calling for regulation of artificial intelligence
story: On September 9 in Warsaw, humanoid robots rented from a robot-rental business marched through the city waving flags to demand AI regulation and protection for human workers displaced by automation.
why_funny: The organiser deployed the exact technology threatening human employment to argue that the technology threatens human employment — and his robot rental business charged for each unit on the march.
